issues.description: Field SealSaloon.totalOrders: the problem statement UML declares the attribute as type int (problem_statement.md: line 28 shows "-totalOrders: int"), but the reference solution declares the field as long (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java line 6: "private long totalOrders = 0;"). This mismatch in the declared type for the same attribute can confuse students about the intended type, expected range, and tests or getters that rely on an int vs a long.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute type consistent between specification and implementation. Either update the UML/problem statement to indicate totalOrders: long (if large counts are expected) or change the solution (and any tests) to use int for totalOrders and update the getter accordingly. Ensure the problem text (which says totalOrders is per-instance and non-static) remains accurate.
